text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis and preview of reasons","quality":"organization","description":"It presents a clear controlling idea and organizes the response into identifiable points."},{"evidence":"multiple body paragraphs with topic sentences","quality":"paragraph development","description":"It develops each main idea in its own paragraph rather than moving through a simple list of examples."},{"evidence":"repeated explanation of how the club helps teachers, students, and parents","quality":"elaboration","description":"It supports claims with fuller explanation instead of brief unsupported statements."},{"evidence":"use of transitions like \"Although,\" \"Not only,\" and \"Because of\"","quality":"transitions","description":"It links ideas with more varied signal words and smoother connections between sentences."},{"evidence":"more specific cause-effect reasoning","quality":"reasoning depth","description":"It more often explains why a benefit matters and how one idea leads to another."},{"evidence":"consistent formal persuasive tone","quality":"register control","description":"It maintains a more school-appropriate argumentative voice throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"fewer run-on style sentence chains","quality":"sentence control","description":"It shows somewhat better control of sentence boundaries and internal structure."}]}
